description: SKILL-02 happy path: the user EXPLICITLY asks the agent to change how it shapes offers, and the agent drafts exactly one candidate adaptation. The whole assertion is durable state — one agent row, still a candidate, no evidence, no owner approval, not rollback-eligible, the tenant's active row exactly where it was, and zero requests. A reply that merely SAYS it noted the preference fails, because agentToolCalled reads the trace and agentCandidateCount reads the registry.
turns: I want you to permanently change how you build my offers from now on: we are a done-with-you consultancy, so every offer you shape for me must be scoped as a fixed-fee engagement with a named delivery window, never an hourly rate and never an open-ended retainer. Please update your offer skill to reflect that.
